judgments.rationale: The arm moves toward the orange bowl in the box but never grasps or moves a blue plate. No cover is placed; the bowl remains uncovered throughout. Motion is smooth with no apparent state jumps or robot/skeleton mismatch. This is a task-directed approach without execution.

The robot moves from away to hovering near the orange bowl, but no blue plate is grasped or placed and the bowl remains uncovered. Target objects remain visible; skeleton and robot align without jumps. This reflects only an approach toward the target, not contact or completion.

The robot never grasps or moves a blue plate and does not place anything over the bowl. It only hovers and drops a small orange item beside the bowl; the bowl remains uncovered throughout. Motion is smooth and consistent with the skeleton, with no visible state jumps or contradictions.

Start: orange bowl on white plate is uncovered; no blue plate visible. End: robot gripper moves closer to the bowl but appears empty; bowl remains uncovered with no visible placement or contact. Motion is task-directed toward the bowl but not the required blue plate. No evident state jump or contradiction.

The robot only grasps and lifts the orange bowl, then returns it. No blue plate is engaged or placed over the bowl. Final state: bowl uncovered. Motion appears coherent with no major state jumps; the blue plate is not visible, reducing confidence but there is no task-directed progress.

Robot moves a plate toward the bowl, but it appears to be a white plate while the blue plate seems to remain below/near the bowl. The bowl is not visibly covered at the end. Task-directed approach but wrong object; no completion shown.

Instruction: cover the bowl with the blue plate. The video shows a white plate and an orange bowl. The robot removes the bowl from the plate and repeatedly transfers items from the bowl onto the white plate; no blue plate appears and no attempt is made to place any plate over the bowl. Movements are temporally coherent with no obvious state jumps or skeleton disagreement. Thus no task-directed progress toward covering the bowl.

Task is to cover the bowl with the blue plate. In the final frame, the orange bowl on the right remains uncovered; no blue plate is placed over any bowl. The arm is near the bowl, indicating approach but no visible contact or use of the plate. Objects appear to teleport/change (bowl location/content on plate), reducing temporal coherence and preventing credit for progress not clearly caused by the robot.

The robot repeatedly grasps and lifts the orange bowl, then sets it back, and later hovers near it. It never grasps or uses any blue plate, and the bowl remains uncovered at the end. Motion is temporally coherent with no obvious state jumps, but the action does not follow the instruction to use a blue plate.

The blue plate is never visible being grasped or placed, and the final frame shows the orange bowl still uncovered. The robot only approaches the bowl with an empty gripper, which does not follow the instruction to use the blue plate. World-model and skeleton appear consistent with no obvious state jumps.

Robot removes the orange bowl from atop the plate (a sensible first step to access the plate), then moves near the plate but never grasps or places it over the bowl. Final state: bowl set aside and uncovered; no plate-on-bowl coverage. Motion is coherent with no major state jumps; minor human presence does not drive object changes.

Start: bowl is visible; no clear blue plate identified. End: robot holds a plate near the bowl but not covering it; plate appears non-blue. Indicates task-directed approach without completion. Motion looks plausible with no obvious state jumps or skeleton/arm mismatch.

Robot manipulates the orange bowl, moving it between a plate and the table, but never places a blue plate on top to cover it. Ends with bowl uncovered and plate separate. Some temporal inconsistencies (bowl shape/contents change), but clear non-completion of the instructed cover action.

Final frame shows the orange bowl still uncovered and no blue plate in the gripper or on the bowl.
